faqs: What details should I send for a quote?
Share your event date, location, guest count, service hours and whether your venue already has a bar.
Can I hire bartenders for a birthday or company event?

/rb/weddings.heading: Miami Wedding Bartenders & Mobile Bar Service
/rb/weddings.description: Hire wedding bartenders and mobile bar service in Miami and South Florida. Compare staffing and full bar options, and request a quote for your reception.
faqs: Can you work with my venue’s existing bar?
Yes. Tell us what the venue provides and which staff or equipment you still need. We can quote staffing or discuss a mobile bar setup.
What bar details should I confirm with my venue?
Ask whether the venue has a built-in bar, when vendors can set up, what alcohol service rules apply, and whether proof of insurance is required.
What should I include in my wedding quote request?
Share your date, venue or city, expected guest count, bar service hours, and whether you need staffing only or a full bar package.
Can we choose signature drinks for the reception?
Yes. Share your preferred spirits, cocktails, and any beer, wine, or champagne service when you request your quote.
points: Staffing only: hire bartenders, barbacks, or servers when your venue already has a bar setup.
Full bar service: ask us about a mobile bar, mixers, garnishes, ice, and setup or cleanup for your guest count.
Wedding drink service: plan signature cocktails, beer and wine, or champagne service for your celebration.

/rb/crafts-cocktails.heading: Crafts & Cocktails: Miami Bottle Painting & Cocktail Making
/rb/crafts-cocktails.description: Paint and decorate a bottle, then mix cocktails in one guided Miami class. Book Crafts & Cocktails for a date night, birthday, bachelorette party, or private group.
faqs: Do we paint bottles and make cocktails in the same class?
Yes. Crafts & Cocktails combines a guided bottle-decorating activity and cocktail making in one session.
Do I need to bring bottles or painting supplies?
The experience includes bottles to decorate, craft supplies, aprons, and cocktails. Check the booking form for available extras.
Can I book this for a birthday, bachelorette party, or date night?
Yes. Start with your group size and preferred session to see the options for your celebration.
How is this different from Mix N’ Sip?
Both experiences teach cocktail making. Crafts & Cocktails adds a bottle-decorating activity, and Mix N’ Sip focuses on mixing drinks.
points: Decorate your own bottle with the craft supplies provided during the session.
